entries.text: That's not what Dad's saying.
entries.translation: 爸爸可不是这个意思

entries.text: That's what you're saying.
entries.translation: 这是你的意思

entries.text: And it's insulting in a whole different way.
entries.translation: 而且是从另一个角度羞辱了我

entries.text: Okay, people. Let's all "Chillax."
entries.translation: 好了 各位都冷静点

entries.text: - Hey, where's Uncle Cameron? - Thank you. Thank you.
entries.translation: -卡梅隆舅夫呢 -多谢多谢

entries.text: Someone who's not insulting me notices he's not here.
entries.translation: 总算有人发现他不在了 而不是光羞辱我

entries.text: Oh, so that's the big announcement, huh?
entries.translation: 原来你的重要消息就是这个啊

entries.text: You two broke up.
entries.translation: 你俩分手了吗

entries.text: Well- Well, a baby wasn't gonna help that anyway.
entries.translation: 领养个孩子也挽救不了破裂的婚姻

entries.text: And let me tell you. You're better off,
entries.translation: 老实说 你们分了也好

entries.text: because he was a bit of a drama queen.
entries.translation: 他就喜欢小题大做

entries.text: No, no, no. Stop. Stop. No.
entries.translation: 不是的 打住 打住

entries.text: You come into my house and you insult me and my boyfriend,
entries.translation: 你们到我家来 还羞辱我和我的男朋友

entries.text: who, by the way, is not that dramatic-
entries.translation: 而且他才没有小题大做

entries.text: We adopted a baby.
entries.translation: 我们领养了一个宝宝

entries.text: Her name is Lily.
entries.translation: 她名叫莉莉

entries.text: - Exciting! - Just turn it off.
entries.translation: -激动吧 -停下来

entries.text: I can't turn it off. It's who I am.
entries.translation: 我停不下来 这就是我的个性

entries.text: - The music. - Oh, yes, the music.
entries.translation: -我是说音乐 -关音乐啊

entries.text: Come say hi to Lily.
entries.translation: 来和莉莉打招呼吧

entries.text: Ay, miren a la princesita.
entries.translation: 看看这个小公主

entries.text: The little princess.
entries.translation: 真是个小公主

entries.text: - She's so cute! - Thank you.
entries.translation: -她好可爱 -多谢夸奖

entries.text: Let me see her. Let me see her.
entries.translation: 让我看看 让我看看

entries.text: Hi there, Lily.
entries.translation: 你好啊 莉莉

entries.text: "Lily." Isn't that gonna be hard for her to say?
entries.translation: 莉莉 对她来说不是很难发音吗

entries.text: - Phil. - Excuse me.
entries.translation: -菲尔打住 -我说

entries.text: Okay, I-I-I know that I said I thought this was a bad idea.
entries.translation: 我知道我说了领养这个主意很糟糕

entries.text: But, uh, what do I know?
entries.translation: 可我又懂什么呢

entries.text: I mean, it's not like I wrote the book on fatherhood.
entries.translation: 我也不是个模范父亲

entries.text: Been trying all my life to get it right. I'm still screwing up.
entries.translation: 一辈子都想做好爸爸 可我还是搞砸了

entries.text: - Right, Manny? - I wrote a song about it in the car.
entries.translation: -对吧曼尼 -我在车上为此写了首歌

entries.text: Of course you did.
entries.translation: 意料之中

entries.text: Anyway, I'm happy for you.
entries.translation: 不管怎样 我为你们感到高兴

entries.text: And, uh, you should know that, uh,
entries.translation: 你们要知道

entries.text: I'm not here to spit in your face,
entries.translation: 我不是来唾你们脸的

entries.text: I'm here to... blow at your back.
entries.translation: 我是来给你们 吹吹后背春风的

entries.text: - I don't understand what that means. - I don't-
entries.translation: -我不懂你的意思 -我也不懂

entries.text: Well, it's- it's supposed to sound better in Spanish.
entries.translation: 这话用西班牙语说比较好听

entries.text: Oh, that's beautiful. That's really nice.
entries.translation: 真好听 真美

entries.text: And thank you too.
entries.translation: 也谢谢你

entries.text: Anyhow, Mitch, uh-
entries.translation: 总之 米奇

entries.text: No, Dad, it's- it's- -
entries.translation: 不用了 爸爸

entries.text: - I got her. I got her. - Oh, she's crying.
entries.translation: -我来抱她 -她哭了

entries.text: She wants her grandpa! She wants her daddy!
entries.translation: 她要爷爷抱 她要爸爸抱

entries.text: - Do you wanna meet Grandpa? - What? Are you kidding?
entries.translation: -想见见爷爷吗 -开什么玩笑

entries.text: She's one of us now. Let me see the little pot sticker.
entries.translation: 她是自家人了 让我瞧瞧你这跟屁虫

entries.text: Hey, you're a cutie, aren't you?
entries.translation: 你真是个小可爱 对吗

entries.text: Ah. Look at this.
entries.translation: 看看这个

entries.text: We're from different worlds, yet we somehow fit together.
entries.translation: 我们来自不同的世界 但我们彼此相容

entries.text: Love is what binds us, through fair or stormy weather.
entries.translation: 爱将我们紧紧相连 共度风风雨雨

entries.text: I stand before you now with only one agenda-
entries.translation: 我到你的前面 只有一事相许

entries.text: "To let you know my heart is yours,
entries.translation: 我的心只属于你

entries.text: Feldman comma Brenda."
entries.translation: 布兰达·费尔曼

entries.text: I mean, seriously.
entries.translation: 不是吧我靠

entries.text: Luke, so far, hasn't beaten me in basketball.
entries.translation: 至今为止 卢克在篮球上还没赢过我

entries.text: It's 2-0. 2-0. Okay. Okay.
entries.translation: 2比0 2比0 来吧

entries.text: - Get that weak stuff out of my kitchen! - Dad, stop it!
entries.translation: -手下败将 滚吧 -爸爸 住手

entries.text: Can you do me a favor? Just grab-
entries.translation: 帮个忙好吗 站过去

entries.text: How's the weather down there?
entries.translation: 篮下的滋味如何

entries.text: But when the day comes that he does win-
entries.translation: 等到他赢过我的那一天

entries.text: if- you know- if/when-
entries.translation: 如果有那么一天

entries.text: he beats me, I'm just gonna be like,
entries.translation: 他打败了我 我会说

entries.text: "Well done. Well done."
entries.translation: 干得好 干得好

entries.text: Just, like, let him- Just support him...
entries.translation: 就这样支持他

entries.text: in- in- in that kind of stuff.
entries.translation: 就是这样

entries.text: I mean, I'd probably want to go, like,
entries.translation: 我可能会说

entries.text: two out of three and just see what happens there, but-
entries.translation: 三局两胜才算赢 再来一局什么的
